verdict: All twelve usable as they stand, no edits. The two bedrooms hold the signed-off style and the corners agree (every side wall shows the right neighbour's end). The corridor's four read as a different, more photographic hand: a question for the owner on the tablet, since the corridor is a passage and may be allowed its plainness, or redrawn with the style paragraph strengthened (about 10 cents).
